reason: The README describes a network-facing administrator authentication gateway that reverse-proxies HTTP, WebSocket, and SSE traffic to a dsh web service, with configurable sessions and request controls.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web 服务提供带管理员密码、会话管理和请求限制的本地认证反向代理网关。
summaries.en: Provides dsh web with a local authentication reverse-proxy gateway supporting administrator login, sessions, and configurable request limits.

capabilities: Starts a local HTTP authentication gateway
Proxies HTTP, WebSocket, and SSE traffic to a configured dsh web upstream
Handles administrator passwords, session cookies, and in-memory sessions
Applies configurable login and request rate limits, host checks, IP allowlists, and request body limits
Reads the administrator password from an environment variable or plugin configuration
